comment: Defects of the game's own data that the engine reports correctly and cannot fix (we never ship or patch game data files). A scene whose only problems match an entry here is reported as KNOWN, not as failed; anything else still fails it. Each entry: the game version, the scene (a shell pattern: "*" any scene, for a defect of the game's timed scripts that shows wherever the sweep happens to be), the game file at fault, the exact text the sweep sees (a substring of the reason), and why it cannot be fixed. Remove an entry once its cause is gone.

defects.error: geometry: resource\models\locations\UnderWater\UnderWater.gm has 86193 vertices but its vertex colour file resource\models\locations\UnderWater\UnderWater_morning10.col has 83897 entries
defects.reason: The game ships a baked vertex colour file made for an older version of the model (2296 vertices fewer). The engine reports it (geom_static.cpp) and draws the model's own vertex colours, as the original engine did; the data is the game's.

The game's scripts define the OldWorld locations (PROGRAM/locations/init/OldWorld.c: OldWorld_Port, OldWorld_Town_Part1..4, OldWorld_Town_Exit), but the game ships none of their models (no RESOURCE/MODELS/Locations/OldWorld) and nothing else in its scripts leads there: unfinished, unreachable content. Entering one, the engine reports the model file it cannot open.

The game's day-change script that moves the free captains (PsHero) between towns reads arDest.t0 of a town without travel paths (the hidden colony SanAndres): missed attribute t0, null ap, no rAP data at lines 924-934. It fires on the day change, whatever scene is loading. The app fixes it with its script patch pgg-travel-target (ledger NEW-PSHERO-T0); the sweep runs the game's scripts unpatched.

The game's scripts define the OldWorld locations (PROGRAM/locations/init/OldWorld.c: OldWorld_Port, OldWorld_Town_Part1..4, OldWorld_Town_Exit), but the game ships none of their models (no RESOURCE/MODELS/Locations/OldWorld) and nothing else in its scripts leads there: unfinished, unreachable content. Without its model the stock location loader unloads the location (LocationLoader: not loaded model); the engine abandons its preparation with an ERROR and the game goes on without a location, so the sweep's load times out.

PROGRAM/sound.c SetStaticSounds plays, for each locator of a location's "sound" group, the alias named by the locator's name without its last two characters (strcut(name, 0, len-3)): "fireplace01" -> "fireplace". These models name their locators with one or three digits or a typo (fireplace1 -> "fireplac", fireplace001 -> "fireplace0", torch1 -> "torc", torchlight101 -> "torchlight1", fireplsce01, cavewind001, locator01), or with a name that has no alias in RESOURCE/INI/aliases/sound_alias.ini (nightinsects, poorman, governor). The engine finds no alias and no file of that name and reports it; the original game is silent there too.

The storm's bow splash (src/libs/sea_foam, as the original engine) plays the alias ship_bow, which TEHO's sound_alias.ini does not define and no file of that name exists.

InitStdBlade gives every blade folder = "items", but the blade models (blade_NN, slave_NN, topor_NN) are in RESOURCE/MODELS/Ammo. A blade lying as a random item in a location (ITEMS/itemLogic.c Items_LoadModel) asks for items\\<model>.gm, which does not exist; the original game shows nothing there either.

defects.error: but its vertex colour file resource\models\islands\Beliz
defects.reason: RESOURCE/MODELS/Islands/Beliz: the model's vertex colour file (.col) was made for another version of the model: its entry count differs from the vertex count. The engine reports it and draws the model's own vertex colours (geom_static.cpp). (_refl and _seabed of the Main's islands carry colour files of 21231 and 10577 entries whatever their size.)
